an5.30:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma Kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tad avasari.
an5.30:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an5.30:1.5: ‘samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an5.30:1.6: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an5.30:1.7: iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā.
an5.30:1.8: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
an5.30:1.9: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an5.30:1.10: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī' ti.
an5.30:1.11: Atha kho Icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya yena Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā. 2.
an5.30:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nāgito Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an5.30:2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ āmantesi
an5.30:2.3: ‘ke pana te Nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macche vilopentī' ti?
an5.30:2.4: ‘Ete bhante Icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādaniyam bhojaniyam ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā Bhagavantaṃ yeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañ cā' ti.
an5.30:2.5: ‘Māhaṃ Nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso.
an5.30:2.6: Yo kho Nāgita na-yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.30:2.7: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā' ti.
an5.30:3.3: yena yen'eva dāni bhante Bhagavā gamissati, tanninnā 'va bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.
an5.30:3.4: Seyyathā pi bhante thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti,
an5.30:3.5: evam eva kho bhante yena yen'eva dāni Bhagavā gamissati, tanninnā 'va bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.
an5.30:3.7: Tathā hi bhante Bhagavato sīlapaññāṇan' ti.
an5.30:4.1: ‘Māhaṃ Nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso.
an5.30:4.2: Yo kho Nāgita na-y-imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī, akasiralābhī,
an5.30:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
an5.30:4.6: Piyānaṃ kho Nāgita vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā,
an5.30:4.8: Asubhanimittānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa kho Nāgita subhanimitte pāṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti,
an5.30:4.10: Chasu kho Nāgita phassāyatanesu aniccānupassino viharato phasse pāṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti,
an5.30:4.12: Pañcasu kho Nāgita upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato upādāne pāṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti,
